_why: W17-DENSITY-B2-B3, 2026-09-04. Band 2's authored findables -- the addendum's (docs/FINISH_THE_MEADOWS_ADDENDUM_2026-09-04.md section B/C) regional batch for Stone & Root, read by scripts/world/band_pickups.gd and stood up through item_cache_pickup.gd. Owner (OWNER_DIRECTIVES_2026-09-04-C section 2-3): candy answers 'why should I explore over there?', so the critical path carries two Good and nothing better; side routes carry Good; the quarry rim loop, the ranger camp spur and the undertrail (the band's three authored detours, terrain_playground.json trail.loops) carry Great; the two Rare sit on the band's hardest optional encounter (Nightburrow's cave mouth) and its deepest branch (the far-west mudsnout pocket, 110m off the spine past the undertrail). Recovery arrives BEFORE the attrition it supports -- the revive and the Wild Shroom on the approach to the Warrens mouth and Pell, the large potion before Kest -- never after a camp. Every `id` is the once-flag (`cache:<id>`) and is unique across the chapter. Positions are world [x, z]; y is asked of the ground (D09). ALL TUNABLE, but move a placement and its `why` together.

pickups.why: the first candy south of the South Bridge, on the road itself: the wrapper is taught as a find before the band asks the player to leave the road for one
the trailpup grove's east edge beside the berry bushes at (135-145,1540): a dozen metres off the road where the pack and the berries already pull the eye
behind Dorn's picket at (315,1668), tucked against the night-duskhush cover at (250,1700): the player who circles the picket instead of walking straight at it is paid
on the quarry's north rim before the descent to the floor and its burrowback nest -- recovery before the quarry fights, not after them
the quarry rim overlook loop's east ledge (loop point (420,1770)), where the whole quarry floor is read from above; the loop is the band's first authored detour and pays Great
on the quarry floor beside the Rootstone seams at (393-406,1792-1809) and the quarry station crate: the floor is where Rootstone is learned, and the candy is the second reason to walk down onto it
among the Rootstone rocks on the worked floor: a Stamina Shroom grown in the stone dust, the defence buff a player wants before the Warrens guardian's wall
the rim loop's south descent (loop point (400,1910)), so a player who finished the overlook loop is paid once more on the way back to the road
off the haul road's west verge between the mudsnout at (240,1950) and the trailpup pack at (262,1995): the first candy the pack itself guards
in the hollow beside the loose-stone node at (28,2118), east of the spine bend at (20,2130): a gather stop that also hides a sweet
on the ground of the alpha trailpup at (-180,2250) r14, a fight the player must choose: a harder optional encounter pays Great (addendum section B tiering)
at the abandoned ranger camp up the spur (loop ranger_camp_spur; camp rest at (-256,2260)), the band's authored rest and the first Team Tether evidence: a detour with a camp pays Great
on the warren undertrail loop (loop point (-380,2540)) below the Warrens' second mouth: the through-route a player only finds by leaving the spine at (-420,2470)
the band's deepest branch: the mudsnout pocket at (-527,2420) sits 110m west of the spine past the undertrail's start, with nothing on the road pointing at it. Deep exploration pays Rare
on the approach to the Warrens mouth before Pell at (-332,2585): the dungeon is the band's attrition, so the revive is met before it, never inside it (prompt 63: no free hotel in the dungeon)
under the ironwood stand at the Warrens' flank (-321..-379, 2570-2645): a Wild Shroom in the leaf litter, the attack buff for the guardian a few metres away
in the ironwood stand south of the mound, among the felling nodes: the player who fells the band's ironwood finds a sweet in the litter
at the alpha meadowhart's ground (-150,2650) r12, off the undertrail's rejoin: the rideable mount's biggest individual guards a Great
on the spine before Kest at (0,2980) and Farro's night watch: the band's last trainer ladder rung, met after the Warrens; the large potion is here, before the fight, not at the seam after it
at Farro's night watch (95,2900) beside the night-gated duskhush alpha at (70,2900): a Speed Shroom for the player who comes out here after dark

on the cave-mouth rock of Nightburrow at (-168,2940) r10, the band's exceptional night-only alpha (spawns order 2100): the hardest optional encounter in Stone & Root pays Rare, and only to a player who found the mouth after dark
off the spine's last bend before the band-3 seam at (0,3180), on the hill above the duskhush at (25,3072): the band ends with a small find rather than a dead walk to the haulage wreck
